# Relay AI

🚀 **Modern AI-powered messaging platform** combining intelligent AI assistants with real-time human conversations.

## Features
- 🤖 **Multi-AI Chat** - Google Gemini 2.5 Flash integration
- 📱 **Real-time Messaging** - MQTT-powered instant messaging
- 📎 **File Sharing** - Images, docs with preview & download
- 👥 **Group Management** - Organized conversations & contacts
- 🔐 **Secure** - End-to-end encryption & privacy controls
- 🎨 **Modern UI** - Responsive design with dark/light themes

## Tech Stack
React 18 • TypeScript • Supabase • Prisma • Tailwind CSS • Framer Motion

## Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/mohdyasin4/relay-ai.git
cd relay-ai
npm install
npm run dev
```
